segment_captions.caption: C uses a spoon to scoop batter from a bowl into cupcake liners on a baking tray.
C uses a spoon to fill cupcake liners with batter, then places a heat-resistant mitt over the tray before putting it into the oven.
C removes a baking tray from the oven using an oven mitt, revealing freshly baked muffins.
C places a baking tray filled with muffin batter into an oven.
C speaks while gesturing with her hands, clasping them together then moving them apart.
C speaks while gesturing with her hands, her expression changing slightly between frames.
C picks up a box of tea bags from a table with a plate of muffins and decorative pumpkins.
C places a matchbox on the table next to a plate of muffins and a pumpkin candle holder.
C places a candle on a tray with pumpkins and a plate of muffins on a table. The tray is then removed from the table.
A woman speaks directly to the camera in a cozy room decorated for fall with pumpkins and candles on a table behind her.
A plate of pumpkin muffins is placed on a checkered cloth atop a wooden table decorated with pumpkins and candles.

A hand reaches out to pick up a muffin from a plate filled with pumpkin muffins. The plate is on a checkered cloth atop a wooden table decorated with pumpkins and a lit candle. The hand gently grasps the muffin, lifting it slightly off the plate.
